contents_summary: Two rendered pages: page 1 is Supplementary Table 1 with 50 per-participant VR training visit rows (5 participants x 10 visits; level, walking speed in m/s, performance score in %), 6 cells printed as x; page 2 holds methods paragraphs and an aggregate correlation table (Table 2) that is not typed as patient data.

pages.contents: Supplementary Data heading and Table 1 (Performance Scores): columns Participant, Visit #, Level, Walking Speed (m/s) and Performance Score (%). Five participant blocks (1 to 5) of ten visit rows each; participant 1 visit 1 and participant 3 visit 10 are printed as x in all three value columns. The blocks for participants 2 and 4 are shaded blue.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Per-participant VR training session records (game level, walking speed, performance score) for participants numbered 1 to 5, matching the article participant labels; the article cites the Supplementary Data for performance scores. Values are not matched to participants by numeric similarity.
limitations: No page-specific rights notice is printed; the article source license is retained without blanket re-licensing.
Visit numbers are session indices, not dates; no calendar or relative time is inferred.
The printed x cells are not defined by any legend and are recorded as missing.

pages.contents: Two explanatory paragraphs and Table 2 (Pearson Correlation with Mean Performance Score) with four rows (DGI, delta DGI, BBS, delta BBS), columns r and p, and footnotes defining abbreviations and significance stars. The first paragraph explains how Table 1 and the performance score were obtained; the second explains the correlation analysis between the mean performance score and the post-assessment outcome measures.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Table 2 is a cohort-level correlation analysis and the paragraphs are methods text; no participant-specific values are given, so nothing on this page is assigned to a participant or typed as a patient fact.
limitations: No page-specific rights notice is printed; the article source license is retained without blanket re-licensing.
The cohort correlation values are aggregate statistics and are intentionally not transcribed as clinical data.
Clinical supplemental data is preserved separately from the original-source clinical target; values absent from the article text are not represented as quotes from its segments.
Supplementary Table 2 (aggregate correlations) is described but not transcribed as clinical data.
